documents.text: The data backup policy requires daily snapshots retained for 7 days. Snapshots run at 02:00 UTC. This is the current data backup policy for all production databases.
Weekly full backups are stored in cold storage for 90 days. Restore drills happen monthly. This is the current data backup policy for all production databases.
